summary: Garden Stage Limited, a Cayman-incorporated Hong Kong-based broker, filed a Form 6-K on August 20, 2026, attaching a notice of extraordinary general meeting and a proposed third amended and restated memorandum and articles. The EGM, first mailed August 13, 2026, is set for August 26, 2026 in virtual format. Shareholders will vote on increasing authorized share capital from US$50,000 (2,453,750 Class A at US$0.02; 9,250,000 Class B at US$0.0001) to US$1,000,000 (49,953,750 Class A; 9,250,000 Class B), adopting the new articles, authorizing registry updates, and permitting adjournment for further proxy solicitation. No deal terms, board recommendation beyond convening, advisor, or special-situation transaction are stated.
